summary.text: Brady Brammer is a Republican state senator from Utah who was appointed to District 21 in November 2024, took office in January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he previously served in the Utah House of Representatives from 2019 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Brady Brammer earned a B.A. in American studies in 2004, a J.D. in 2007 and an M.P.A. in 2008, all from Brigham Young University.
His career includes work as an attorney at several law firms and as a shareholder of Spaulding Law, and he was previously a member of the Highland Planning Commission.
Brammer served in the Utah House of Representatives from 2019 to 2025, where he chaired the Administrative Rules Review Committee in 2021-2022.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026.
